summary: Implemented `in` membership for Namespace and ClosedNamespace in rdflib/namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ checks node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs; _RDFNamespace inherits it. The IPython key-completion hook now returns dir(str(self.uri)) per the spec. Added three tests to test/test_namespace.py (prefix membership, RDFS closed membership, RDF closed membership). Tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed. Note: the completion hook change lists string methods rather than term names, so it may need revisiting.
